# Chinese Menu Decoder

A traveler's Chinese menu decoder — browse, translate and order real Chinese dishes with English names, Chinese characters, pinyin and price ranges.

## Core sections

- Menu map (six menu sections in order): https://www.chinese-menu.com/#anatomy
- Dish explorer (48 signature dishes): https://www.chinese-menu.com/#explorer
- City menus (6 cities): https://www.chinese-menu.com/#city-menus
- The eight great cuisines: https://www.chinese-menu.com/#cuisines
- Taste guide (six flavors): https://www.chinese-menu.com/#taste
- At the table (etiquette and phrases): https://www.chinese-menu.com/#at-the-table
- FAQ (28 traveler questions): https://www.chinese-menu.com/#faq

## Data

48 signature Chinese dishes with English name, Chinese name, pinyin, region, category, dietary tags, price range and description.

Six cities (Beijing, Shanghai, Chengdu, Xi'an, Guangzhou, Chongqing) with signature menus, food streets and daily budgets.

Eight great Chinese cuisines (Sichuan, Cantonese, Shandong, Jiangsu, Hunan, Zhejiang, Fujian, Anhui) with flavor profiles, techniques and ordering tips.
